description: One of the departments in the country, skilled in technology, Kerala Police has stepped up to provide training in disruptive technologies of AI and Data analytics.
body_lead: Results for " One of the departments in the country, skilled in technology, Kerala Police has stepped up to provide training in disruptive technologies of AI and Data analytics. The objective of this step is to stay ahead in the era of digital transformation. A training programme is specially designed by the country’s first on-campus digital university, the Digital University of Kerala to aid the police department in their novel venture.
